instructions: What should the NetHack player do next? Weigh the game goal, if one is given.

hint.instructions: Which nav hint should the player read to choose the next move? Pick the one whose line best answers the situation.

options.far: per-direction open-run length without doors: cross open ground in a straight line (a run of 1 beside a wall is the wall itself)
options.new: the tiles revealed since the last call: follow what just opened up, such as a door or a new room
options.frontier: the nearest unexplored edge or corridor dead end: explore when there is no better lead (S14)
options.paths: per-direction escape or dead-end line, doors marked +, 0 is blocked: retreat, or read a dead end before searching it (S14, S30; a run of 1 beside a wall is the wall itself)
options.least_explored: quadrant coverage ranked emptiest first: choose the next room to explore (S29)

menu.fight: attack: melee an adjacent hostile, or fire or throw at one in line; never melee a floating eye or gas spore, never attack a peaceful or a pet; fire or throw first at a heavy hitter not yet adjacent; mold, lichen or acid blob: route around or shoot, melee an acid blob only if it is the sole way past; kill any other hostile, XP raises HP (G3, G7, S6 to S8)
menu.rest: rest or search in place; only with no hostile in view, never while Hungry, Weak or Fainting, at most 10 turns per call, and below 70 percent HP on the upstairs or in a dead end (G4, G5, S30)
menu.move: walk, to retreat or to explore; search a dead end only after stepping onto its unrevealed neighbours, walk a branch to its end before calling it a loop, push a boulder from every angle (S14 to S16)
menu.engrave: engrave Elbereth to disengage when retreat will not open distance; humans (@) and minotaurs ignore it (S5)
menu.pray: pray to the god, a last resort that works only at very low HP (5 or less, or about 1/6 of max HP at mid levels), not at zero HP (S5)
menu.pickup: pick up or loot items or gold here; after a kill step on its drop and read it; open a chest where it lies and force it only if locked, take items from the list, never with A, never take a gray stone (S9, S11)
menu.interact: talk to a peaceful or a shopkeeper (read every price), or use a fountain, altar, sink, throne or statue (S20)
menu.item: use an item: apply, quaff (including a healing potion), read or zap; engrave-test an unknown wand; never dig down with a monster within 2 squares (S10, S28)
menu.eat: eat food from the pack; a Monk never eats corpses, except a wraith's (S9)
menu.equip: wear, wield or put on gear from the pack that beats what is worn (more AC, a better enchantment, an empty slot), or take off a worse piece; a Monk fights bare-handed and wears no armor or weapon by default (S12)
menu.cast: cast a known spell, such as sleep (Za, direction) at a dangerous adjacent or lined-up monster; needs 5 Pw; elves, vampire bats and lights resist (S26)
menu.descend: take the stairs down, only when every descent_check is true (HP above the limit, not hungry, no status or burden, nothing adjacent) and not fleeing; otherwise rest or heal first (S4)
